title: It's ok, could be a lot better
text:
It's ok, could be a lot better. I'm not thrilled with this unit, but I don't hate it either. I've used it twice with mixed results so far. The entire machine is unbalanced and I have to sort of slip something under one leg to make stay level for cooking.

As to the actual omelettes, they are edible and better than expected once you figure out the quantities. The first time we used 4 eggs, cheese, and ham and it was clearly too much. The middle never really cooked. I ended up throwing all of it in a skillet and just doing a scramble. The second batch, we used 2 eggs, cheese and ham and everything was done completely. Unfortunately, that's just a single serving for an adult, so you end up doing a second batch as well.
